mapper.sql: organization_id, organization_code, name_masked AS organization_name, description, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, version

where.if: deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'DELETED'
AND ( LOWER(organization_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(name_masked) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tbl_dim_organization
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, organization_code ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_organization ( organization_id, organization_code, name_masked, description, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version ) VALUES ( #{organizationId}, #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{description}, #{status}::record_status, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_organization SET organization_code = #{organizationCode}, name_masked = #{organizationName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}::record_status, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH target_customers AS ( SELECT customer_id FROM tbl_dim_customer WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} ), updated_customers AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_customer SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customers) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING customer_id ), target_projects AS ( SELECT project_id FROM tbl_dim_project WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customers) ), updated_projects AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_project SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING project_id ), target_repositories AS ( SELECT repository_id FROM tbl_dim_repository WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) ), updated_repositories AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_repository SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE repository_id IN (SELECT repository_id FROM target_repositories) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING repository_id ), cancelled_tickets AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_ticket SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND status <> 'CANCELLED' RETURNING ticket_id ), disabled_project_roles AS ( UPDATE tbl_auth_member_project_role SET active_flag = FALSE, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND active_flag = TRUE RETURNING member_key ), disabled_access_scopes AS ( UPDATE tbl_auth_member_access_scope SET active_flag = FALSE, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} OR customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customers) OR project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) OR repository_id IN (SELECT repository_id FROM target_repositories) RETURNING access_scope_id ) UPDATE tbl_dim_organization SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_dim_organization WHERE organization_code LIKE CONCAT(#{organizationCodePrefix}, '%')
